title: Add evaluator_clean writer
description: Added WRITE_EVALUATOR_CLEAN config key (default True), write_evaluator_clean() standalone function, and wired it into Output_Writer.write() so that the main write also produces output/evaluator_clean/{direction}_evaluator_clean.json with only direction and rules_set (extra metadata stripped).
notes_for_reviewer: The write_evaluator_clean function is placed in output/writer.py alongside the existing Output_Writer class.
Output_Writer.write() calls write_evaluator_clean() after the main write, gated by getattr(_cfg, 'WRITE_EVALUATOR_CLEAN', True).
The clean file is written to <parent>/evaluator_clean/<direction>_evaluator_clean.json (e.g., outputs/evaluator_clean/long_evaluator_clean.json).
The standalone function uses strategy['direction'] and strategy['rules_set'] directly (not validated) so it works with any dict that has those keys.
Config key WRITE_EVALUATOR_CLEAN = True is added near OUTPUTS_DIR in the Phase 0 section.
9 unit tests pass: 6 standalone + 3 wiring tests, including coverage for the config flag set to False.
All 50 existing output_writer tests and 3 property tests continue to pass.

Phase files are NOT modified in this task — the wiring happens through Output_Writer.write. Phase writes that use json.dump directly will need a separate follow-up if clean files are desired from those paths.
